Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.outbound

Interface ClinicalTrialPort

All Known Implementing Classes:
ClinicalTrialAdapter
public interface ClinicalTrialPort
Outbound port for persisting and querying ClinicalTrial records.

Implementations live in the infrastructure layer (e.g. JPA adapter). Provides a deduplication check by NCT ID to prevent storing duplicate trials across harvest runs.
